sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names riding rural recovery and Ramadan restocking, led by IATA, IMAS, and ECII, while avoiding laggards with weak distribution. Momentum is broadening beyond staples into discretionary food and personal care; add on pullbacks toward 5-day moving averages. Trim positions in names already up >10% intraday to lock gains ahead of potential profit-taking.
